# Orange-Pi-5-Pro hardware matrix

Maintainers have this board, so functions can be verified on hardware.

*Profile* is the profile that provides the function: `free`, `full` (needs non-free artifacts) or `blocked`. See [Free vs non-free](Orange-Pi-5-Pro-Free-vs-NonFree).

| Function | Status | Profile | Features | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bluetooth | implemented-unverified: BCM4345C5.hcd from nixpkgs raspberrypi-wireless-firmware | free | orangepi5pro-core |  |
| boot | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-image |  |
| cpu-dvfs | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-core |  |
| emmc | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-image |  |
| ethernet | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-core, orangepi5pro-ethernet-10-100 |  |
| gpu | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-core |  |
| leds | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-core, orangepi5pro-leds-off |  |
| nvme | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-core |  |
| serial-console | implemented-unverified | free | orangepi5pro-core |  |
| wifi | implemented-unverified: brcmfmac43456-sdio firmware from nixpkgs raspberrypi-wireless-firmware; its NVRAM is the Raspberry Pi's, not AP6256 calibration | free | orangepi5pro-core |  |
